name: contextweave-backend
description: The mock API and the seeds/ingests that author its documents. Zero runtime dependencies, on purpose.
//start: Elastic Beanstalk's Node platform runs `npm start` when there is no Procfile, so `start` has to exist and has to be the server. `mock` is kept as the name the docs and every developer already use; both run the same thing, and neither passes a port so the platform's PORT wins.
//engines: Deliberately absent. Elastic Beanstalk reads engines.node and cannot resolve a range like ">=22", so it warns ("used the default Node.js version for your platform version instead") and falls back — noise on every deploy for a constraint the platform choice already expresses. Pick the platform version instead: "Node.js 22 running on 64bit Amazon Linux 2023".
